title: CLR/31/2023 of RAJ MUNISHA Vs ARVIND KUMAR GARG

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND
AT NAINITAL
 THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA
07th MAY, 2024
CIVIL REVISION NO.31 of 2023
Raj Munisha. .....Revisionist
Versus
Arvind Kumar Garg. .....Respondent
Counsel for the Revisionist : Mr. Alok Kumar,
Advocate.
Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Tapan Singh,
 Advocate.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
Heard Mr. Alok Kumar, learned counsel for
revisionist and Mr. Tapan Singh, learned counsel for
respondent.
2. A SCC Suit (No.03 of 2021, "Arvind Kumar Garg
Vs. Smt. Raj Munisha") was filed by the respondent-plaintiff against the revisionist-defendant. Written
statement was not filed by the revisionist. Learned IInd
Additional District Judge, Haridwar has directed the said
SCC Suit to proceed under Order VIII Rule 10 of the Code
of Civil Procedure, 1908 vide impugned order dated
17.02.2023.

2
3. The revisionist has requested to grant one more
opportunity to file the written statement within a week
from today.
4. Mr. Tapan Singh, Advocate, appearing for
respondent-plaintiff, has opposed the said submission
orally.
5. In the interest of justice and in order to decide
the dispute arising in the said SCC Suit on merit, the
revisionist-defendant is granted one week's time from
today to file his written statement on the cost of
Rs.25,000/-(Rupees Twenty Five Thousand).
6. If the written statement is not filed within the
said period, no further opportunity shall be granted to the
revisionist to file his written statement.
7. Present Civil Revision (No.31 of 2023) stands
disposed of accordingly.
___________________
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Dt:07.05.2024
Neha
